title: BMW Canada further improves EV convenience in Canada with Shell Recharge integration and access to NACS-format Superchargers (2026-04-08)
notes: Supercharger access from 2026-04-08 per vehicle via remote software upgrade; CCS-port cars need the approved Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter; only all-new models sold in Canada from 2026 (iX3, i3) get a built-in NACS port. Page does not name the i4 in the text read; the model list was seen in a search excerpt.
